name: openai-compatible-imagegen
description: Generate, annotate, edit, and manage OpenAI-compatible image artifacts in Codex App.

interface.longDescription: Connect to a local OpenAI-compatible image runtime through MCP, keep image results in the current conversation, and open a focused canvas for multi-area annotation, editing, and version navigation.
defaultPrompt: Generate or edit an image in the current conversation, then open its focused canvas when annotations are needed.
